text_blocks.snippet: Stroke epidemiology studies the patterns, causes, and effects of stroke within populations. Globally, stroke is a leading cause of death and disability. In the United States, about 795,000 people experience a stroke each year, with the majority being first-time strokes. Prevalence rates vary by age, race, and sex, with older adults, Black individuals, and males generally having higher risks.
